confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on several broadly consistent guide figures, though some are undated or cover Portugal as a whole. Accommodation anchors are low confidence: the Porto-specific hotel data was dated (2024) or covered the wider district, and the July peak season is an estimate. Cocktail and wine anchors are estimates from the local beer relationship and thin bar data. Euro figures were converted at an assumed 1.16 USD per EUR without a fetched rate. The FX observation came from a search result summary of the RBA table, not a direct read of the RBA page, and no 16 October RBA figure was verified.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was substituted. Anchors are based on Porto-specific sources, with Portugal-wide guides as secondary support. Sources describe Porto as cheaper than Lisbon, which was used only as a qualitative upper reference.
